emerging_watch: Watch whether US Energy Complex confirms a leadership handoff over AI Infrastructure: the rotation margin is only 0.185 and energy's breadth (0.636) is much stronger than AI's (0.125). The observable to watch is energy_complex's score rising while ai_infra's breadth stays below 0.2 and its r10 stays negative — if energy_complex overtakes ai_infra by more than 0.2 and ai_infra's durability_bar drops below 0.4, the watch resolves to a confirmed rotation; if ai_infra's breadth recovers above 0.3, the watch retires.

theses.subject: AI Infrastructure
theses.thesis: AI Infrastructure is rank-1, eligible (above the absolute-trend gate), not crowded (crowding_z 0.15), and still the rotation leader. Per the discipline, this is a stay/participate lean rather than a momentum-chase: the trend gate is the supported leg, not the rank. Breadth is thin (0.125) and score has a negative 10-day momentum reading (r10 -0.0916), so I keep conviction low and treat the eligibility as the main reason to lean rather than avoid.
theses.dissent: Thin breadth (0.125) and a negative r10 (-0.0916) suggest leadership is resting on a few names and momentum is already cooling; a handoff to the Energy Complex (challenger) could leave this theme stalled even if the gate holds.

falsifier.text: SMH breaks below its absolute-trend gate level before the 20-day check-by date and ai_infra drops out of eligible status, or energy_complex's score overtakes ai_infra by more than 0.2 with ai_infra still non-crowded

theses.subject: US Energy Complex
theses.thesis: US Energy Complex is the clear challenger (1.375) with the best breadth among leaders (0.636), eligible, and not crowded (crowding_z 0.93). The rotation.leader/challenger margin is small (0.185), so this is a sensible second leg of the same trend discipline. Crowding is not yet a fade signal, so a modest lean is permissible rather than avoidance.
theses.dissent: crowding_z 0.93 is close to the caution zone, and the rotation breadth is narrowing (0.45); energy leadership may be a late-cycle rotation that reverses if the AI trade reasserts.

falsifier.text: XLE lags SMH by 5% over the next 25 trading days while energy_complex breadth contracts below 0.4

theses.subject: Cybersecurity
theses.thesis: Cybersecurity is rank-3 and eligible with the strongest trend-health profile (hurst_tag=trend, durability_bar 0.75), which would normally support participation. However it is flagged crowded=true (crowding_z 1.61), the highest in the eligible set. Per the guardrails, crowding is a size-DOWN caution, not a fade, so I express this as underweight rather than avoid — trim participation rather than exit.
theses.dissent: The strong trend leg (hurst=trend, durability 0.75) may keep grinding higher; crowding in a persistent trend theme often resolves by time, not drawdown, so an underweight could underperform a simple stay.
